title: Remote Control
subtitle: Live interactive desktop sessions on online endpoints
view_only_notice: You are signed in with view-only access. You can watch session history, but starting a desktop session requires the technician role.
filter_placeholder: Filter by hostname, ID, or site
empty_online: No endpoints are online. Remote control needs a live agent connection.
duplicate_hostname_title: Multiple devices share this hostname. Identified uniquely by Device ID.
badge_terminal_only_title: Desktop capture is available on Windows and Linux (X11). Remote Terminal supported.
start_title: Open a live remote desktop session
start_requires_technician: Starting a session requires the technician role
terminal_hint: Desktop capture is available on Windows and Linux (X11). Use the Interactive Terminal from the Devices page.
terminal_title: Open the remote terminal. Desktop capture is available on Windows and Linux (X11).
select_endpoint_sessions: Select an endpoint to see its sessions
select_endpoint_history: Select an endpoint to load its remote control history.
empty_history: No remote control sessions recorded for this endpoint.
footer_hint: A session sends this operator's mouse and keyboard to the endpoint in real time. Every session is recorded in the audit trail with its operator and frame count.
frame_version_mismatch: The endpoint sent screen layout version {version}, but this console speaks version {expected}. The agent and the console are different builds.
relay_lost: Lost the connection to the remote control relay. The endpoint or the network may have dropped.
endpoint_offline: Endpoint is offline or disconnected from central hub. Remote control requires an active agent connection.
no_interactive_session: No interactive user session logged into Windows desktop (Session 0 lock). Remote desktop capture requires an active logged-on user session.
capture_stopped: The endpoint stopped sending its screen ({reason}). Showing the last frame; it resumes on its own when capture recovers.
cannot_stream_default: This endpoint cannot stream a desktop. Remote control needs a platform capture backend.
session0_note: {reason} (Note: Windows services run in Session 0; ensure an interactive user is logged into the physical desktop and the screen is unlocked).
no_frames: Connected to the relay, but the endpoint sent no screen frames. If the endpoint recently reconnected from offline, ensure an interactive user desktop is logged on (Windows lock screen restricts remote screen capture).
clipboard_sent: Clipboard text sent to the endpoint. Paste it there with Ctrl+V.
clipboard_copied: The endpoint clipboard is now on your clipboard.
file_too_large: {name} is {size}; the endpoint accepts up to {limit}.
upload_session_closed: The session closed during the upload.
fps_title: Screen updates per second. An update carries only the rectangles that changed, so a still desktop sends none — that is the point, not a stall.
stats_title: Image quality the endpoint is encoding at, adapted to how fast this link drains, and the rate it is sending.
scale_title: The endpoint is sending a smaller picture to keep the session fluid while the screen is busy or the link is slow. It returns to full size when the screen is still.
low_bandwidth_title: For a slow connection: the endpoint sends a half-size picture at lower quality, so the session stays responsive. Remembered in this browser.
keys_title: Send a key combination your browser cannot pass through
send_clipboard_title: Send your clipboard text to the endpoint's clipboard
copy_remote_title: Copy the text last copied on the endpoint
send_file_title: Send a file to the endpoint's Downloads\Remote Transfers folder
control_title: Take control of the endpoint: mouse and keyboard are forwarded
view_title: Watch without sending input to the endpoint
clipboard_read_blocked: Your browser did not allow reading your clipboard. Paste the text here to send it.
clipboard_write_blocked: Your browser did not allow writing to your clipboard. Copy the endpoint text from here (Ctrl+C).
viewport_label: Remote desktop for {hostname}. Keyboard input is forwarded to the endpoint. Click the desktop to focus it, then type.
waiting_first_frame: Waiting for the endpoint to attach and send its first frame...
focus_hint: Click the desktop to focus it, then type. Keys are forwarded to {hostname}.
needs_logged_in_user: Remote control needs a person logged in at the endpoint so the agent has a desktop to attach to. Ask them to sign in, then start a new session.
capture_failed_hint: Remote desktop capture failed. Verify endpoint agent logs and screen capture prerequisites, then retry.
session_ended_text: The desktop streaming session was closed by the operator or endpoint.
badge_desktop_linux_title: Screen and input over X11, plus a full terminal. A Wayland desktop cannot be captured yet: the endpoint user can log in with an X11 (Xorg) session instead.
history_load_failed: Could not load the session history for this device.
input_failed: The endpoint did not accept the input: {reason}
